blocks.raw:
{"type": "code", "title": "Stok minus per gudang", "summary": "Kueri SQL untuk mencari stok minus per gudang.", "language": "sql", "code": "SELECT w.name AS gudang, p.default_code, SUM(q.quantity) AS stok
FROM stock_quant q
JOIN stock_location l ON l.id = q.location_id
JOIN stock_warehouse w ON w.id = l.warehouse_id
JOIN product_product p ON p.id = q.product_id
GROUP BY w.name, p.default_code
HAVING SUM(q.quantity) < 0
ORDER BY stok ASC, w.name, p.default_code;"}
